mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS extensionId FROM fcc_telephony_node n JOIN fcc_extension e ON e.extension = #{extension} AND e.status = 'ENABLED' AND e.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE n.node_id = #{nodeId} AND n.status IN ('ONLINE', 'DRAINING') LIMIT 1

SELECT e.id AS extensionId, a.id AS agentId FROM fcc_telephony_node n JOIN fcc_extension e ON e.extension = #{extension} AND e.status = 'ENABLED' AND e.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN fcc_agent a ON a.work_no = #{owner} AND a.status = 'ENABLED' AND a.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE n.node_id = #{nodeId} AND n.status IN ('ONLINE', 'DRAINING') FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fcc_agent a JOIN fcc_agent_presence p ON p.agent_id = a.id WHERE (a.work_no = #{owner} OR a.current_extension = #{extension}) AND p.active_call_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE fcc_agent_endpoint_binding b JOIN fcc_agent a ON a.id = b.agent_id SET b.status = 'DISABLED', b.valid_to = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE b.endpoint_type = 'SIP' AND b.status = 'ENABLED' AND (a.work_no = #{owner} OR b.endpoint_value = #{extension})

UPDATE fcc_extension e JOIN fcc_agent a ON a.work_no = #{owner} AND a.status = 'ENABLED' AND a.deleted_at IS NULL SET e.agent_work_no = a.work_no, e.agent_name = a.agent_name WHERE e.extension = #{extension} AND e.status = 'ENABLED' AND e.deleted_at IS NULL
